about: The store build of this tree (Google Play and the App Store). The vendoring script's store targets read this file and never ship it: every X.store.js replaces its X.js sibling, the paths under drop are left out, and the lexicon rows below are rewritten or removed. Each sort_ row here reads exactly as it does in games/sort/setup-lex.store.js, the door's fallback table. See core/storesafe.js.

set.sort_source_online_off: Online pictures aren't available in this version
